description: Stations d'épuration collectives du département de la Manche is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Location of collective treatment plants in the department of Manche. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Collective wastewater treatment plants of the Department of the English Channel" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include département, données ouvertes, station d'épuration, manche, cd50, assainissement. The listing shows 2019-02-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
